name: OpenTTD
hint: Open-source transport tycoon server, joined by invite code

GAME_TYPE.title: Visibility
GAME_TYPE.description: Players join with the invite code printed in the app's logs ("Invite code: +...", new on every restart): Multiplayer, Add Server, paste the code. OpenTTD's game coordinator relays the game when a direct connection fails, after asking the player once. Players with IPv6 can also add the app's address on port 3979. "public" also lists the server in the in-game server list.

SERVER_PASSWORD.title: Server password
SERVER_PASSWORD.description: Leave empty to let anyone with the invite code join.
